Approvals are the main bottleneck
Podsumowanie

Executive Summary Across accepted interviews, the dominant throughput limiter is approval latency and changeover variability.

Odczyt konsultingowy

Executive Summary Across accepted interviews, the dominant throughput limiter is approval latency and changeover variability. What we heard (facts) Approvals create queue time between planning and execution. Changeovers on Line 3 are long and inconsistent. Excel is used as the “integration layer”, delaying visibility. Implications Decisions arrive too late to prevent overtime and expedite costs. Teams optimize locally due to missing shared metrics and owners. Quick wins (30–60 days) Introduce a lightweight approval SLA (who/when/escalation). Start SMED pilot on top 3 SKUs. Daily dashboard: OTIF, changeovers, top blockers.
